visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with long dark hair, wearing a black cap with a white logo and a black Jurassic World t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit retail space filled with gachapon machines. He smiles and points toward a specific pink machine displaying retro flip-phone toys. (2) Close-up view of the man's hands inserting coins into the pink machine and rotating a green mechanical knob. He then reaches down to retrieve an orange plastic capsule from the delivery slot. (3) The man holds the open orange capsule, which contains an item wrapped in layers of clear bubble wrap. He carefully unwraps the object using both hands to reveal a miniature light-blue flip phone with a silver hinge and a small chain. (4) He flips the miniature toy phone open, revealing a tiny numeric keypad and a screen with colorful cartoon graphics. He holds the toy up to his ear, smiling and laughing as he pretends to take a call in the middle of the store. (5) The scene transitions to an indoor setting with a light wood-paneled floor. The man's hand flicks the blue toy phone open with a rapid wrist movement and then pulls out a retractable silver antenna from the top corner of the device. (6) A final close-up focuses on the phone's screen which displays musical notes. As buttons are pressed, the tiny screen glows slightly, and the man demonstrates the toy's mechanical flipping action and its functional buttons for the camera.

The speech is clear and expressive. (2) Sharp mechanical clicking sounds occur rhythmically as a gachapon knob is turned, followed by a dull plastic thud of a capsule hitting a tray. (3) High-frequency crinkling and rustling sounds of bubble wrap and plastic dominate the mix as an item is handled. (4) A recorded female voice saying 'Hello' repeats from a small, low-fidelity electronic speaker source, sounding robotic and tinny. The main male speaker laughs in response. (6) The male narrator continues to speak with high vocal arousal as he manipulates the toy, with the toy's low-fidelity music and vocal recordings overlapping his speech.
